comments.text: We are way past the point where easy solutions are obvious or even possible. Keeping dangerous things secret means you need to trust the people that do have access to those things to not use them against you, and even before that, to recognize the dangers before actually putting the whole world at risk and decide not to; but the alternative is not simple as it is with regular software, open-sourcing AI lets people have a more even playing field against otherwise powerful entities, and allows more eyes to seek for potential issues and figure out how to solve them, but it also hands to malicious people tools that may have permanent significant harmful effects at a global scale. comments.author: @XAirForcedotcom
comments.text: There’s not just the concern about the primary AI becoming too smart, but other AI’s being used to take advantage of that intelligence and then using it for harm, even if that wasn’t what it was intended for.  It could be something physical, like putting a robot in a Tesla.  The Tesla won’t hurt anyone but the robot in it could shoot everyone going down the street..   That could manifest in many ways.  Even with some loose security that they may have, it could be over written very easily in a scenario like that were a second AI developed by an individual takes the intelligence from the first system and uses it to harm others.  This is not simple.  You’re really going to have to think about what is happening because that’s towards the worst case scenario of something actively harmful.  This will be the smartest thing that we ever make and if you are not taking steps to make sure it’s safe right now you are absolutely going to harm humanity. Being so disruptive that it puts all of the workers out on the street is another scenario.  You’re going to have to text these companies that if people are replaced that they’re putting enough back in to the government through taxes to ensure that everybody will still be fine even if they don’t have a job.   It could be great to take ourselves out of the process to make earth, more productive, and efficient, but you have to think about everything else that lives here on earth at the same time.
